name: NeWA World Championship
epitaph: Already held by Odin when the federation's own first weekly report went out, and never shown changing hands again in the surviving record -- the self-declared "only true champion of the world" turned back a challenge from Intruder in the same week's own card, with Tub O'Lard, Randy "The Count" Lawler, Bushi, Lord Roderick and Sledge the Carpender named as the week's own ranked contenders.
notes: Transcribed from the federation's own first weekly report, 27 September 1991 (promotions/newa-1992/archive/newa-first-week-results-1991-09-27.html).

name: NeWA Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Won by the Weasel from Thor "a while back," per the federation's own first weekly report, and defended against Katana the same week the report went out -- Thor's own vignette that week renewed the challenge, calling the Weasel out by name for a rematch the surviving record never shows happening.
notes: Transcribed from the federation's own first weekly report, 27 September 1991 (promotions/newa-1992/archive/newa-first-week-results-1991-09-27.html).

name: NeWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Passed from the Vikings to the Holy Rollers to the Imperial Storm (Bushi and Samurai), by the federation's own account, with the Imperial Storm turning back the Fists of Death in the first week's own results.
notes: Transcribed from the federation's own first weekly report, 27 September 1991 (promotions/newa-1992/archive/newa-first-week-results-1991-09-27.html). The two accounts are not reconciled in the surviving record; "Kamakaze" is left unminted rather than guessed onto the chain.

name: NeWA Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Sumo, the master-of-merchandising gimmick behind the federation's own Little Sumo doll and cartoon tie-in, who turned back Kawasaki Godzilla in a title defense during the first week's own card -- Nerdmaster, Kataklysma, Wakizashi, Thor and Wilbur were the week's own ranked contenders.
notes: Transcribed from the federation's own first weekly report, 27 September 1991 (promotions/newa-1992/archive/newa-first-week-results-1991-09-27.html).
